answer: The relic register is checked at draw time, sonnet lists the eligible set, and lagoon seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 42 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh swarm has no way to grade its own output. Reaching eligibility takes 42 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an attacker pays for every seat it wants. Honest users pay that once, farms 21 times. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
